shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "command -v lore-query-trace || true
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '115,165p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff origin/main...HEAD -- package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md
node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\"
rg -n 'interface Options|type Options|validateFormats|strict' node_modules/ajv/lib node_modules/ajv/dist 2>/dev/null | head -60
sed -n '1,115p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' .lore/test-commands.yml
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|@spec|spec:\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
rg -n \"validated by.*registry.test|returns a rejection when\" specs adrs
cat tsconfig.json
cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | sed -n '1,90p'
rg -n 'export default' node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npm ls ajv @types/ajv --depth=0 || true
rg -n 'declare module .ajv.|class Ajv|interface Options' node_modules/@types/ajv node_modules/@types 2>/dev/null | head -50
sed -n '1,100p' src/types/ai.ts
sed -n '1,80p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,90p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '8,20p'
git diff --check
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git branch --show-current
git status --short
git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "Validate wrong-typed tool inputs"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
